bucket_seam.evidence: lib/config.py:14 defines S3_BUCKET once, from the process environment (BD_S3_BUCKET, default opal-data-bd). At base 96f3212d22, 42 gold scripts imported it and used that one name for every get_object, list, put_object and copy in the same process, so reads and writes were bound to one bucket per process; the only switch was the environment variable. As re-read at the phase A worktree (FB-f-9), 45 scripts import it: D_00f.advisor_nna_canonical.py no longer hard-codes its bucket (its former literal 'opal-data-bd' is now the seam's S3_BUCKET), and lib/platinum_dest.py and tests/test_platinum_dest.py import it. Every platinum write now passes through destination() (lib/platinum_dest.py): with the mode unset it is the identity, so each write keeps the S3_BUCKET bucket and key; the canonical mode sends the served platinum keys to the bucket and key of the generated view. separable_per_output stays false for the base.
